reason: A browser-side DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that provides a synchronized sidebar index for user conversation turns, with navigation, highlighting, pagination, and responsive layout behavior.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供按用户提问组织的对话轮次侧边栏索引，并支持点击跳转、滚动联动高亮和响应式布局。
summaries.en: Adds a conversation-turn index sidebar to the DeepSeek Harness web interface with click-to-jump navigation, scroll-synchronized highlighting, pagination, and responsive layout.

capabilities: Reads the current conversation snapshot to render turn indexes
Adds a browser-side sidebar overlay to the chat interface
Scrolls to and highlights conversation message rows
Stores interface preferences in browser localStorage
